upstream_api_review.spec_delta_from_previous_binding: Additive over 0.9.0-rc.15: client operations 113 -> 116 with GET /playback/sessions/{id}/disc (DiscListing: the files of a folder-disc session, each with id, path below the disc root, size and content_revision; at most 10000, truncated when cut) and GET|HEAD /playback/sessions/{id}/disc/files/{file_id} (HTTP Range reads of one disc file). Version and PlaybackSession add the required nullable disc (Disc: layout folder for a BDMV / VIDEO_TS folder with format bluray or dvd, layout image for an .iso with format null); file_size is null for a folder disc. Default playback never picks a disc; a session for a disc version needs its version_id and profile.allow_unverified=true. An image session streams the .iso through stream_path; a folder-disc session answers stream_path with 409 disc_folder. Capability features add disc_versions and disc_folder_files; no new limits. The full specification also updates the administration task descriptions (Dolby Vision backfill defaults and failure codes, TMDB season read back-off). No typed SDK schema change: the typed Version reads only its existing fields.
